title: Company research fields
brief: Each item is a short, made-up company page. For each item, return the company's name as written, its headquarters country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, the year it was founded, its headcount band (one of 1-10, 11-50, 51-200, 201-1000, 1000+) and its website domain without www. Use only what the page says.
limitation: Five short synthetic pages with the facts stated in the text. Not web research, conflicting sources, private companies with no page, or judging whether a company is a good prospect.

items.input: Halcyon Freight moves temperature-sensitive cargo across the Nordics. Started in a Gothenburg garage in 2014, the company is still headquartered in Sweden and now employs 140 people across four depots. Learn more at https://www.halcyonfreight.example.
About Brightwell Analytics GmbH: founded 2019 in Munich, Germany. Our team of 32 data engineers builds pricing models for retailers. Contact: hello@brightwell-analytics.example
Orchard & Pine is a two-person design studio in Portland, Oregon (USA). We opened our doors in 2021. Portfolio: orchardandpine.example/work
Since 1998, Meridian Ledger Ltd has provided outsourced bookkeeping from its head office in Leeds, United Kingdom. More than 2,400 staff serve clients in 12 countries. www.meridianledger.example
Tidewater Robotics (est. 2008) designs autonomous inspection drones for offshore wind farms. Head office: Esbjerg, Denmark. Headcount: 610. Visit https://tidewater-robotics.example/about

title: Lead list fields
brief: Each item is a short, made-up team page. For each item, find the most senior person responsible for sales or revenue and return their full name, their title as written, their seniority (one of C-level, VP, Director, Manager, Individual contributor) and their work email, built from the email pattern the page gives.
limitation: Five short synthetic team pages where the email pattern is stated. Not finding or verifying real contacts, checking that an address delivers, or judging buying intent.

items.input: Halcyon Freight leadership: Erik Lund, CEO. Priya Natarajan, Chief Revenue Officer. Tom Berg, Sales Manager. Emails follow first.last@halcyonfreight.example.
Brightwell Analytics team: Jonas Weber (CTO), Lea Hoffmann (VP Sales), Max Braun (Account Executive). Reach anyone at firstinitiallastname@brightwell-analytics.example, for example jweber@.
Meet Meridian Ledger's commercial team: Aisha Khan, Head of Sales; Ben Ortiz, Sales Development Representative; Clara Moss, Marketing Coordinator. Addresses use first@meridianledger.example.
Orchard & Pine is two people: Sam Rivera, founder and designer, and Jo Chen, who handles new business as Sales Lead. Write to first.last@orchardandpine.example.
Tidewater Robotics sales: Lars Dahl, Account Executive; Nina Holm, Senior Account Executive. Our founders handle engineering, not sales. Emails are first.last@tidewater-robotics.example.
